unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U21: Distinguish taxable computation,exempt income,deductions and assessment stages

payload.title: Classify the amount before applying a tax rate
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source computation separates income under the relevant heads, gross total income, permitted deductions and taxable income. Exempt income is not simply a deduction chosen after applying a rate, and a deduction is not automatically a rupee-for-rupee tax credit. The applicable regime and eligibility conditions determine what can be used.

Filing a return, processing it, scrutiny and reassessment are also distinct events. An acknowledgement is not proof that every computation was substantively accepted. The textbook deadlines and revision limits are not used as current universal rules; a working file needs the governing year, Act and current instrument for each date.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a return acknowledgement prove all claimed deductions were finally allowed?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Filing and substantive assessment are separate.
